cues.text: Listen, the plane is taking off.
To take off means to leave the ground and start flying.
Now, gently imagine you’re fastening your seatbelt and getting comfortable.
You carefully recline your seat, finding a cozy position where you can rest.
To recline your seat means to move the back of your seat backward.
There is a blanket and a pillow waiting for you.
Wrap yourself in the blanket, place the pillow behind your head, and let your body relax.
Listen.
You can hear the gentle hum of the plane.
A hum is a low, continuous sound that you can hear in the background.
To make it even more comfortable,
imagine you put on a pair of noise-cancelling earbuds so that you can look out the window and enjoy the view.
As you look out the window,
you can see the beautiful blue sky and the mountains passing slowly below you.
To look out the window means to look outside through a window.
But when you look at the window, you notice the window itself.
You can see that it’s clean, and there is a button you can press to close it.
You press the button to close the window, and at the same time, you close your eyes.
Breathe in…
and breathe out…
Enjoy this cozy flight.
Bye.
